{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for QA orders: revenue = 999999.99
# First, parse revenue to float to compare
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Identify QA orders
qa_mask = df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
print(f"Number of QA orders: {qa_mask.sum()}")

# Check if any QA order is in the loyal segment
loyal_mask = df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal'
qa_in_loyal = qa_mask & loyal_mask
print(f"Number of QA orders among loyal customers: {qa_in_loyal.sum()}")

# Now, compute conversion rate among loyal customers, excluding QA orders
# Filter out QA orders first
df_filtered = df[~qa_mask].copy()
loyal_filtered_mask = df_filtered['customer_segment'] == 'loyal'
converted_loyal_filtered = df_filtered[loyal_filtered_mask]['converted']

# Compute conversion rate
total_loyal_filtered = len(converted_loyal_filtered)
converted_loyal_count = converted_loyal_filtered.sum()
conversion_rate_filtered = converted_loyal_filtered.mean()

print(f"Total loyal customers (after removing QA): {total_loyal_filtered}")
print(f"Converted loyal customers: {converted_loyal_count}")
print(f"Conversion rate: {conversion_rate_filtered}")"}
